_derivation.note: official_fields.json is PORTED from gam-native's generated REST reporting catalogue (backend/src/domain/gam_reporting_catalogue_generated.py, revision 20260528), itself generated by scripts/coverage-audit/7_generate_reporting_catalogue.py from the GAM REST discovery snapshot _audits/coverage-current/gam_rest_discovery_v1.json. REST-only: GAM SOAP is deprecated/removed, so only ALL_REST_DIMENSIONS (765) / ALL_REST_METRICS (527) are carried; SOAP-only fields are dropped.
_derivation.counts: 765 dimensions + 527 metrics (REST). Each field carries its Data format (MONEY/DOUBLE/PERCENT/INTEGER/...) which drives micros-division (MONEY) and drop rules (ratios).
_derivation.report_type_compatibility: GAM fields are valid only under specific report types (12 usable: HISTORICAL, REACH, AD_SPEED, FUTURE_SELL_THROUGH, YOUTUBE_CONSOLIDATED, PARTNER_FINANCE, ...). This is the GAM analog of Meta's breakdown_compatibility: a selection is refused BEFORE submit if a field is incompatible with the chosen report_type (gam-native REPORT_TYPE_DIMENSIONS / REPORT_TYPE_METRICS + find_report_type_incompatible_items).
